facts.statement: Brother Walfrid helped found Celtic in 1887.
facts.prompt: Before the trophies, there was a purpose. Which Celtic founder turned football into a way to help Glasgow’s poor?

facts.statement: Celtic was formed to raise money to feed people in need.

facts.statement: Celtic was formally constituted at St Mary’s Church Hall.

facts.locator: Formal constitution, 6 November 1887

facts.statement: The name Celtic was intended to connect Scottish and Irish cultures.
